Definition: from G3811; tutorage, i.e. education or training; by implication, disciplinary correction:--chastening, chastisement, instruction, nurture.
BiblicalUsage: Paideia is training, education, and the discipline that corrects. Fathers bring up their children in the nurture and admonition of the LORD, Scripture is profitable for instruction in righteousness, and the chastening of the LORD seems grievous for the present but yields the peaceable fruit of righteousness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's training is proof of sonship, not its absence. He corrects the children He loves, and the correction bears fruit in those who endure it.
